main_turf.surface: Turf (Kikuyu and Couch grass mixture on well-draining sandy loam)
main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). Premier country racing venue in the Southern Riverina region of NSW on the Murray River, operated by the Corowa Race Club. Features a expansive 1,900m oval circuit with broad sweeping cambered turns and a 380m home straight. The broad 1,900m layout provides a fair playing field for all running styles (E, P, S, C). Sprint starts from the 1000m chute have a 250m run-in to the turn, slightly favoring inside draws (1-5). Route distances (1400m, 1600m) benefit from a long back-straight run where wide barriers are easily overcome.
main_turf.post_bias: BALANCED DRAW ON ROUTES / MINOR INSIDE ADVANTAGE IN SPRINTS: Over 900m and 1000m, draw positions 1-5 hold a slight advantage into the home bend. On 1300m, 1400m, and 1600m routes, barrier draw penalties are minimal due to the long run-up into the back turn.

handicapping_angles.corowa_cup_showcase_feature: The Corowa Cup ($75k+ Showcase Handicap, March) is the marquee event of the Corowa racing season. Class levels elevate significantly to High Country/Provincial grade. Upgrade horses shipping in with proven NSW Country Showcase or Victorian midweek benchmark form (+3.5 pts class angle).
handicapping_angles.victorian_cross_border_shipper_advantage: Located on the NSW/VIC border, Corowa attracts high-volume Victorian trainers shipping across the Murray River from Wodonga, Wangaratta, Echuca, Benalla, and Euroa (e.g. Craig Widdison, Ben Brisbourne, Mitchell Beer, Lindsay Park). Victorian provincial form carries a strong speed figure advantage over regional NSW rivals.
handicapping_angles.sweeping_1900m_circuit_fairness: Corowa's large 1,900m circumference and wide cambered turns prevent front-runner locks. Strong-finishing swoopers ('S' and 'C' styles) with strong final 400m sectionals receive ample opportunity to run down early leaders in the 380m home straight.
handicapping_angles.riverina_and_albury_wagga_form_flow: Form flows directly between Corowa, Albury, Wagga, Narrandera, and Tocumwal. Horses with proven performance over Albury's clockwise turf track transition seamlessly to Corowa.
handicapping_angles.sandy_loam_fast_recovery: The sandy loam soil base provides good natural drainage. On Good 3/4 surfaces, the track plays fast and even across all lanes. On Soft 5/6, lane 3-5 off the inside rail often becomes the preferred racing groove late in the card.
handicapping_angles.typical_distances: Standard distances: 900m, 1000m, 1200m, 1300m, 1400m, 1600m. Dedicated chutes at 1000m and 1400m.
